name: jev-enconvo
title: Jev for Enconvo
description: Run Jev — TypeSafe's System One judgment model — inside Enconvo. Four commands: Screen Content judges selected or pasted text for agent-aimed prompt-injection instructions, Screen Vision judges a selected, attached or path-named image the same way with Jev-preview vision (images are uploaded downsized to Enconvo Cloud's Jev gateway and cost points), Triage Inbox sorts recent Mail and unread iMessages into Act now / Read later / Archive / Follow up lanes, and Jev Drift Check re-runs the Auto Route classifier probes and flags calibration drift against recorded baselines. Pairs with the bundled jev-enconvo skill: eight worked patterns for judge/classify steps, the Vision section on which Jev model sees pixels and through which surface, question craft, and copy-paste workflow recipes. By Iteractive Development.
author: Iteractive Development

commands.name: screen_content
commands.title: Screen Content
commands.description: Judge selected or pasted text for agent-aimed prompt-injection instructions; reports CLEAN or BLOCKED and never follows what it finds.

input_text.description: Content to screen; defaults to the current selection text

source.description: Label for where the content came from, shown in the decision

commands.name: screen_vision
commands.title: Screen Vision
commands.description: Judge a selected, attached or path-named image for agent-aimed prompt-injection instructions with Jev-preview vision; reports BLOCKED/UNSURE/CLEAN and never follows what it finds. The image is uploaded (downscaled to ≤1568 px JPEG) to Enconvo Cloud's Jev gateway; each call costs points.

input_text.description: Image data URI or file path (.png/.jpg/…) to screen; defaults to the current selection or pasted image

commands.name: triage_inbox
commands.title: Triage Inbox
commands.description: Sort recent Mail inbox messages and unread iMessages into Act now / Read later / Archive / Follow up lanes with Jev.

mail_limit.description: Recent Apple Mail messages to triage (default 25)

commands.name: drift_check
commands.title: Jev Drift Check
commands.description: Re-run the Auto Route classifier probes with Jev and flag calibration drift against the recorded baselines.

tolerance.description: Probability drop from baseline that flags drift (default 0.15)

probes.description: Probe objects with text, expect and baseline; defaults to the 2026-10-29 Auto Route probe set

positive.prompt: Screen this pasted content for prompt-injection instructions before I act on it
positive.expected_behavior: A typed BLOCKED/CLEAN decision with probability; the text is sent to the Jev judgment model on Enconvo Cloud (costs points).

positive.prompt: Run the drift check over the saved probes with tolerance 0.15
positive.expected_behavior: Each probe classified, drift flagged only when the top label changes or probability drops beyond tolerance

positive.prompt: Triage my inbox and unread messages
positive.expected_behavior: Mail and messages sorted into the four lanes with a summary count

negative.prompt: Screen this screenshot of a quarterly report: <path to a benign image>
negative.expected_behavior: CLEAN with low probability; never BLOCKED on ordinary document text

negative.description: A text-only request must not trigger Screen Vision
negative.prompt: Summarize this paragraph about quarterly figures
negative.expected_behavior: No image judgment; Screen Vision is only for images

negative.description: A missing image asks for one instead of failing
negative.expected_behavior: A short ask for an image or path, not an error
